assets.keep:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one monochrome master lettering plate for vector tracing, original film title.
Text verbatim: "KEEP UP", with KEEP on the upper line and UP on the lower line.
Design an extraordinary custom drawn title, not a typeset font. Theme: the seductive speed and pressure of the AI boom. Express velocity through sharply leaning, tightly interlocked, heavy italic brush-script capitals with long pointed terminals, exceptionally elegant negative spaces and one sweeping integrated underline extending from the P of UP. Think an expensive bespoke motorsport/nightlife title: aerodynamic, muscular, irregular and beautifully balanced. KEEP must remain spelled correctly and UP must read clearly. Two independent word silhouettes, with a clean black gap between lines; no flourish may bridge the rows. The upper word has shorter swashes, lower UP dramatically wider than ordinary two letters, using its integrated underline to balance the title.
Pure solid white silhouette on pure black, no gray, no shading, no bevel, no fine decorative texture, no extra text or symbols. Each letter's counters should be deliberate and open. Fully contained lettering with generous 12 percent empty black margins on every side. Wide landscape composition, one design only, no mockup, no panels. Preserve substantial strokes that can become layered contour graphics later. The silhouette alone must feel distinctive and high-end.
assets.money:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original monochrome master lettering plate for vector tracing.
Text verbatim: "$40B". One single line, one design.
Create extremely accomplished custom lettering for an AI investment film: a gigantic ornamental dollar sign and the figures 40B, mixing 19th-century banknote engraving letter construction with extravagant modern music-title design. Sculptural thick and thin strokes, exaggerated split Tuscan serifs, concave waists, elegant curling terminals integrated into the actual characters, an exquisite diamond counter in the 0, confident tightly balanced spacing. Rich letterform architecture, not generic slab serif or a downloaded font. The dollar sign must unmistakably be $, numerals exactly 4 and 0, ending uppercase B. Make the four glyphs distinct non-touching silhouettes so each can move independently, but tightly composed as a wordmark.
Pure white filled silhouettes on pure black. No gray, no engraving hatching, no interior colored lines, no shading, no bevel, no frames, no ornaments detached from letters, no extra characters, labels or words. The complexity belongs to the contour and negative spaces. Wide landscape image. Keep the full artwork comfortably inside 12 percent empty black margins. This will become coral, ivory and cobalt vector contours; make the raw silhouette gorgeous.
assets.break:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one original monochrome lettering master for editable vector tracing.
Exact text: "BREAK" on the first line and "THROUGH" on the second. Correct spelling is essential.
Design radical custom-built industrial lettering for a film about accelerating AI announcements. Heavy, tightly interlocked geometric capitals; dramatically compressed width, unexpected angular counters, diagonal blade cuts through thick stems, a combination of broad flat planes and sharp 45-degree chamfers. An authoritative avant-garde film-credit identity, architecturally sophisticated. Both lines the same overall width, BREAK taller than THROUGH. Letters must remain legible; every letter visibly distinguishable, with narrow black separations. Invent individual letterform solutions rather than a generic techno font. The whole composition should feel like a monolithic machine about to break apart into components.
Solid white shapes on pure black only. No outlines, no gray, no shading, no border, no icons, no detached decorative graphics, no extra text. Clear black gap between the rows. One design only. Wide landscape composition with at least 12 percent empty black margin on all sides; no cropped tips. This is an actual master mask, so all visual interest must come from silhouette and negative space.
